name: Havells India Ltd
business: Havells India Limited is a leading fast-moving electrical goods (FMEG) company and power distribution equipment manufacturer. Its main segments span established categories like cables, switchgear, and consumer electricals, alongside emerging renewable energy solutions and the Lloyd consumer durables business.
tone: Positive and resilient, with management expressing an optimistic outlook on demand and margins heading into the festive season despite short-term raw material inflation and margin pressures.

ledger.promise: Accelerated capacity building investments in cables & wires with an additional capex commitment of over Rs. 340 crores announced during Q1 FY26
ledger.evidence: Reported financial statements do not disclose segment-wise capex spend for cables & wires.
ledger.quote: an additional CAPEX commitment of over Rs. 340 crores announced during the quarter.

ledger.promise: Doubling capacities in underground cables from FY24 to FY27
ledger.evidence: Target completion is FY27; the reported data extends only through Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026).
ledger.quote: actually, if you see from FY '24 to FY '27, we will be doubling our capacities in underground cables

ledger.promise: Solar business revenue could cross Rs. 1,000 crores to Rs. 1,500 crores in the next couple of years
ledger.evidence: The multi-year horizon (FY27/FY28) has not concluded, and segment revenue breakdown for solar is not provided in reported numbers.
ledger.quote: We definitely see that it could cross maybe Rs. 1,000 crores - Rs. 1,500 crores in the next couple of years.

ledger.promise: Targeting switchgear contribution margins between 37% and 40%
ledger.evidence: Reported quarterly data provides company-level operating margins (ranging from 7.0% to 12.0%) but does not provide segment contribution margins.
ledger.quote: 38% to 40% is something which we try to look at in the switchgear segment.

ledger.promise: Aiming for contribution margins in cables and wires between 14% and 16%
ledger.evidence: Segment-level contribution margins for cables and wires are not disclosed in the reported quarterly financials.
ledger.quote: our aspiration has always been between 14% - 15% for contribution margins for cables and wires business.

ledger.promise: Channel inventories for summer products will normalize by the end of Q3 FY26
ledger.evidence: Channel inventory metrics are not provided in the reported numbers for Q3 FY26 (sales were Rs. 5,588.0 crore, up 14.3% YoY).
ledger.quote: we believe that the channel inventories will normalize by the end of Q3.

ledger.promise: Working capital levels are expected to normalize by Q4 FY26
ledger.evidence: Full year Mar 2026 CFO was Rs. 1,572.0 crore vs net profit of Rs. 1,689.0 crore (cash conversion ratio of 0.93), but detailed quarterly working capital levels are not reported.
ledger.quote: Although we expect working capital to normalize by Q4, the other income has remained relatively low in H2, considering the planned capex spend.

ledger.promise: FY26 capex will be about INR 1,450 crores
ledger.evidence: Annual reported tables provide CFO, net profit, and borrowings, but actual capex spend for FY26 is not detailed.
ledger.quote: FY 25-26 will be about INR1,450 crores

ledger.promise: Expects 150 to 200 bps margin expansion for Havells stand-alone over the medium term
ledger.evidence: The medium-term horizon is still active. Company OPM was 9.0% in Q2 FY26 and stood at 9.0% in Q2 FY27.
ledger.quote: That's why I'm very confident that these are the kind of things with productivity improvement, with cost rationalization, premiumization, I think that's something which we have to achieve.

ledger.promise: Room AC industry price increase of 5% to 10% in Q4 FY26
ledger.evidence: Q4 FY26 sales grew 2.5% YoY to Rs. 6,705.0 crore, but product-level realized price increases for ACs are not detailed.
ledger.quote: overall, there could be a 5% to 10% increase in this quarter.

ledger.promise: Entire planned cable plant capacity operational by end of FY27 or Q1 FY28
ledger.evidence: Target completion window is Q4 FY27 to Q1 FY28; current reported period ends at Q2 FY27.
ledger.quote: So hopefully by the end of this year early next year first quarter we'll be having the entire capacity which was planned.

ledger.promise: Revenue growth will return to double digits in full quarters sooner than later
ledger.evidence: Sales grew by 19.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 (Rs. 6,518.0 crore) and accelerated to 34.6% YoY in Q2 FY27 (Rs. 6,432.0 crore).
ledger.quote: we should be seeing double digit sooner than later. All this has happened also due to the volatility and timing differences between passing price hikes and all that. But otherwise, in full quarters, we will definitely see it coming back to double digits.

ledger.promise: Advertising and promotion spends will normalize to around 2.7% to 2.8% of net sales for FY27
ledger.evidence: FY27 is ongoing (only H1 FY27 reported), and A&P spend lines are not broken out in quarterly reporting.
ledger.quote: our long-term average has been around close to 2.7% of revenue as a company as a whole. I'm not getting into consumer otherwise. We expect that to remain the same even for the current year.

ledger.promise: Total capex of about INR 1,400 crores (INR 14 billion) in FY27, largely for cables & wires and R&D centre
ledger.evidence: FY27 is still underway, having reported only through Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026).
ledger.quote: nearly around INR1,400-odd crores of capex for '27... bigger part of that is going into the cables and wires business, almost about INR800 crores. About INR200 crores is going into the new R&D center.

ledger.promise: Full expansion in underground cables on stream in the next 18 months
ledger.evidence: Target completion date falls in early CY2028 / FY29, beyond the available financial data.
ledger.quote: Rajiv Goel: I think the expansion is pretty much on track, that's what we had pointed out. And I think by in next 18 months, the full expansion will be on stream.

ledger.promise: Over a period of time, reduce Lloyd RAC share from close to 75% to around 60% with growth in non-RAC products
ledger.evidence: This is a long-term structural mix goal made in Q2 FY27 without subsequent reported product-mix data.
ledger.quote: Rajiv Goel: RAC continues to be the large part of the business, close to almost 75%. And hopefully, over a period of time, we want to bring it to around 60% with growth in the non-RAC products.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth delivery matched the narrative: management promised in Q1 FY27 that full-quarter growth would return to double digits, which was immediately validated by 19.5% YoY sales growth in Jun 2026 and 34.6% YoY in Sep 2026.

Margin expansion promises diverge from actual profitability: management repeatedly targeted medium-term margin improvements of 150-200 bps, but OPM declined to 7.0% in Jun 2026 and remained flat at 9.0% in Sep 2026 compared to 9.0% in Sep 2025.
Capex guidance escalated significantly from initial estimates: FY27 capex was guided at ~Rs. 1,000 crores in Q2/Q3 FY26, but was subsequently increased by 40% to Rs. 1,400 crores by Q1/Q2 FY27.
bull: Strong top-line acceleration in H1 FY27, with sales reaching Rs. 6,518.0 crore (+19.5% YoY) in Jun 2026 and Rs. 6,432.0 crore (+34.6% YoY) in Sep 2026.
Healthy annual cash generation, with FY26 CFO of Rs. 1,572.0 crore against net profit of Rs. 1,689.0 crore (93% conversion).
Prudent leverage balance sheet with borrowings declining from Rs. 319.0 crore in Mar 2025 to Rs. 265.0 crore in Mar 2026.
bear: Operating profit margin contracted to 7.0% in Jun 2026 (down from 9.0% in Jun 2025) despite 19.5% revenue growth, showing operating deleverage or price-cost lag.
Net profit in Jun 2026 declined 16.7% YoY to Rs. 290.0 crore from Rs. 348.0 crore in Jun 2025.
Subdued growth in late FY26 with Q4 FY26 sales growing just 2.5% YoY (Rs. 6,705.0 crore vs Rs. 6,544.0 crore in Mar 2025).

credibility.line: Management delivered convincingly on top-line growth commitments, though operational margins remain volatile and several segment-level and capex targets lack granular reporting.
